admission.justification: Enforces KNO-R13@v1 AC-1.2 native-grammar crash isolation across engine, smoke subprocess, and LRU service while guaranteeing bounded resource consumption and UTF-16 offset correctness across CRLF, astral characters, and BOM inputs.

applicability: All catalog and custom tree-sitter highlight query compilation and text highlighting executed through highlights_service.highlight_text, highlights_smoke._smoke_compile, and highlights_engine.compute_highlights.
conditions: Every catalog or custom query bundle is smoke-compiled in a short-lived child process before in-process compilation, caching verification outcomes in _VERIFIED_BUNDLES.
Query composition resolves ; inherits: directives recursively with cycle protection and deterministic ordering.

compute_highlights normalizes CRLF and lone CR on a copy, sweeps overlapping captures in O(M log M) with @none and JSON key suppression, enforces HIGHLIGHT_MAX_BYTES (512 KiB) and HIGHLIGHT_MAX_SPANS (20,000), and emits UTF-16 code-unit offsets.
Missing grammars, unwarmed caches (when allow_download=False), oversized payloads, smoke-compile failures, or QueryError degrade cleanly to None without failing reads.
exclusions: Persisting highlight payloads to disk or Git memory trees.
Client-side CodeMirror decoration clamping or theme styling (covered by AC-3).

evidence: mcp/tests/test_unified_tree_sitter_highlights.py (152 passed, 235 subtests passed on clean-copy tree 8e2b8ed2889265fea2a81be8c3fb8e889a194990)

statement: Every catalog or custom tree-sitter highlight query bundle is smoke-compiled out-of-process before in-process use, resolves ; inherits: directives with cycle protection, runs a deterministic O(M log M) precedence sweep handling @none suppression and JSON key suppression, enforces HIGHLIGHT_MAX_BYTES and HIGHLIGHT_MAX_SPANS caps, and emits \n-normalized UTF-16 code-unit spans.
title: Highlight bundles smoke-compile out-of-process and emit capped UTF-16 spans
